A Complete Guide to Leading a Small Group.
The health and success of a ministry is hinged directly
to the health and success of our small groups. Our
ministry is comprised of the building blocks of small
groups. Considering the importance and complexity
of the task it is disturbing to reflect on how little
training small group leaders actually receive. And that
is where this resource fits into the ministry.
“The Ultimate Roadtrip” was written to communicate
all of the subtle, and not so subtle, nuances of leading
a small group. It covers content, group dynamics,
atmosphere, vulnerability and questions that help
create a life-changing community. It fully equips the
small group leader for the task they’ve been entrusted
with and fills out the teaching with dozens of relatable
